Yow! Mi ago teach yuh fi make Jerk Chicken:

🔥 JERK CHICKEN RECIPE:
• 2 lbs chicken
• 2 scotch bonnet peppers
• 4 cloves garlic
• 1 inch ginger
• 2 tbsp allspice
• 2 tbsp brown sugar
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• Juice of 2 limes

Blend all seasonings, marinate chicken 4+ hours, then grill till crispy! 🇯🇲

Big up! Let mi show yuh Rice and Peas:

🍚 RICE AND PEAS:
• 2 cups rice
• 1 can coconut milk
• 1 can kidney beans
• 2 cups water
• 2 scallions
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 scotch bonnet (whole)
• Salt and pepper

Boil coconut milk with beans and seasonings, add rice, cover and simmer 20 mins! Irie!

Respect! Here's how fi make Curry Goat:

🐐 CURRY GOAT:
• 3 lbs goat meat (or lamb)
• 3 tbsp curry powder
• 2 onions diced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 potatoes
• 2 cups water
• Salt and pepper

Season meat with curry overnight, brown in pot, add vegetables and water, simmer 2 hours till tender!

Cho! Let mi teach yuh Ackee and Saltfish:

🐟 ACKEE AND SALTFISH:
• 1 can ackee (or fresh)
• 1 lb saltfish
• 1 onion
• 2 tomatoes
• 2 scotch bonnet peppers
• Oil for cooking

Soak and boil saltfish, flake it, sauté with vegetables, gently fold in ackee. National dish right deh so!

Wicked! Here's Escovitch Fish recipe:

🐠 ESCOVITCH FISH:
• 2 lbs snapper
• 2 carrots julienned
• 1 onion sliced
• 2 scotch bonnet peppers
• 1/2 cup vinegar
• Oil for frying

Fry fish till golden, make pickle with vegetables and vinegar, pour over fish while hot. Sweet and sour vibes!

suggestions.text: Show me beautiful places in Jamaica

Yow! Jamaica full a beautiful places!

🏔️ BLUE MOUNTAINS: Cool climate, coffee plantations, hiking trails with amazing views

💧 DUNN'S RIVER FALLS: Famous waterfall you can climb, cool pools for swimming

🌊 DOCTOR'S CAVE BEACH, MONTEGO BAY: Turquoise water, soft sand, healing properties!

🎵 TRENCH TOWN: Bob Marley's neighborhood, culture yard, music history!
